description: What practices near a London postcode district charge for a treatment, lowest first, read by hand from each practice's own price list, with the NHS charge and which nearby practices say they are taking new NHS patients. Covers Tower Hamlets, Hackney, Southwark, Newham, City of London, Islington, Lewisham, Waltham Forest, Haringey, Redbridge, Greenwich, Barking and Dagenham, Lambeth, Camden and Bexley so far. Every price carries its source page and the date it was read. Always pass on the urgent-care line.

max_miles.description: How far from the middle of the district. Default 2, the same as toothache.fyi's treatment pages. 1 is walking distance, 6 a short drive.

postcode.description: The first half of a UK postcode (the district), e.g. "E14" or "EC1M". Send only that: a full postcode works but only the first half is used.

treatment.description: What the person needs. "emergency" for pain now; "checkup" if unsure; "implant" means the implant and its crown for one tooth.

name: find_dentist
title: Dental prices and NHS places near a postcode
